purpose: International deployment planning; no clinical authorization or runtime configuration changes

report_modules.name: Laboratory reports
report_modules.available: Structured result ingestion and follow-up rules
report_modules.needs: Verify local assay names, original units, laboratory reference ranges and patient context; validate the selected rules locally.

report_modules.name: Radiology report text
report_modules.available: Report rules, English/Korean synthetic checks and a local OpenI text pilot
report_modules.needs: Independent clinician labels, patient-separated evaluation and validation in each report language; preserve negation, uncertainty and amendments.

report_modules.name: Pathology report text
report_modules.available: Rule-based follow-up examples; clinical performance unestablished
report_modules.needs: Specialist-reviewed terminology, specimen context, report amendments and local reference labels.

report_modules.name: Clinical notes and referrals
report_modules.available: Structured workflows and research extraction tools
report_modules.needs: Validate temporal context, medication and referral reconciliation, negation and missing records for the chosen use.

report_modules.name: Medical images
report_modules.needs: Separate validation for each modality, task, model version and population, plus the applicable regulatory assessment.

required_reviews: Clinical lead: define intended use, users, population, report types and exclusions.
Local clinical specialists: review guideline applicability and sign off versioned rules.
Privacy and security team: approve private hosting, access controls, encryption, audit, retention and recovery.
Institutional and regulatory reviewers: determine the requirements in the deployment country before patient care.
Independent clinicians: establish reference labels and assess patient-separated performance, missed cases and false closures.
Hospital pilot team: complete a prospective silent run, workflow review and predefined acceptance criteria.

sources.title: IMDRF: Software as a Medical Device — Clinical Evaluation
WHO: Regulatory considerations on artificial intelligence for health
